components.name: list
components.element:
<List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <TextField source="id"/>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>

components.name: create
components.element:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required()]}/>
   <ConfigField resource="user" name="tags">
    <TransformField expression="{choices: tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))}">
     <SelectInput source="editor" validate={[required()]}/>
    </TransformField>
   </ConfigField>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Entities">
   <ArrayInput source="entities" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <TextInput multiline sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Config">
   <ArrayInput source="config" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <TextInput source="name"/>
     <TextInput multiline source="value" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Contents">
   <ArrayInput source="contents" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <TextInput source="name"/>
     <BooleanInput source="single" label="Single"/>
     <TextInput multiline source="options" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
     <TextInput multiline source="projection" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Components">
   <ArrayInput source="components" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <TextInput source="name"/>
     <TextInput multiline source="element" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>
